decisions.statement: The outages carried between runs are kept beside the units rather than in a page.
A ledger that will not parse is read as holding nothing rather than throwing.
An entry stating no day the service broke is dropped rather than carried.
A service is marked told only once the telling has landed.
A telling nobody takes is carried to the persona stated instead.
A telling that lands nowhere at all leaves that service to be told again.
The tellings after a telling that lands nowhere still go out.
Services that could not be read end the run rather than reading as well.
The run's exit says whether the services could be read rather than whether a telling landed.
Every service whose verdict changed is left carrying this run's finding.
This run's own page is left carrying the moment this run looked.
A verdict is left before any telling.
A run that cannot tell still leaves a verdict.
Something tells Alan when this run is the run that is broken.
A tick may be handed what systemd says rather than asking systemd itself.

definition: the run telling each persona which of the services she answers for is broken
